name: krill-work
description: Work-axis krill plugin: MCP access to krill's spec surface plus the milestone/delivery-axis tools and the full task lifecycle (create/claim/heartbeat/complete/abandon/note/dependencies, M3-M5), plus planner/worker/validator/system-validator/mergepush personas and plan/implement/validate skills forked from project-manager. Swimlane execution is krill-native (no GitHub Issues/Projects) whenever a krill Milestone scopes the work; GitHub remains the fallback only for a FeatureSet with no Milestone -- see CONVENTIONS.md.
